cases.question: Explain the difference between conservation and restoration

answer.answer_text: Conservation means caring for an object so it stays stable and lasts longer, changing as little as possible. Restoration means actively repairing or rebuilding it to look closer to an earlier state. Think of an old wooden chair: conservation might mean controlling humidity and gently cleaning it; restoration might mean replacing a broken leg and repainting it. Conservation usually tries to keep original material; restoration accepts more visible change. Which approach is right depends on the object's purpose and history.
